help.intro1: Isixhumanisi sokusesha sinezingxenye ezintathu: **Sesha**, **Phenya**, kanye no-**Imiphumela**. Zichazwe ngokuningiliziwe ngezansi.
help.intro2: Ungaqala ukusesha noma kusuka engxenyeni ethi **Sesha** noma engxenyeni ethi **Phenya**.
help.searchDesc: Le ngxenye ibonisa izinqubomgomo zakho zokusesha zamanje futhi ikuvumela ukuthi uthumele amagama okhiye ukuze usesha emphakathini.
help.search1: Ukuthumela ngakunye okusha kungeza amagama okhiye afakiwe ohlwini lwezinqubomgomo zokusesha.
help.search2: Ukuze uqale ukusesha okusha esikhundleni sokungeza amagama okhiye ekusesheni kwamanje, sebenzisa inkinobho ethi **Susa Isihlungi**, bese ufaka amagama akho okhiye amasha.
help.search3: Ukuze uthathe indawo yegama lokhiye elithunyelwe sekwedlule, qala ulisuse ngokususa itiki yalo, bese uthumela igama lokhiye elisha.
help.search4: Ungalawula ububanzi bokusesha kwakho ngokukhetha lapho okuzosesha khona. Izinketho zilezi:
help.search5: **Kubababhali noma kubasizi:** Sesha amagama akho okhiye emagameni ababhali noma abasizi.
help.search7: **Kuzo zonke izinkambu:** Sesha amagama akho okhiye kuzo zonke izinkambu zerekhodi lethalabhali.
help.search8: **Kumadokhumenti:** Sesha amagama akho okhiye emibhalweni yamadokhumenti atholakalayo.
help.search9: Ungasebenzisa abasebenzi be-boolean namagama akho okhiye. Isibonelo:
help.search10: **I-AND:** Ithola izingenelo ezinawo wonke amagama achaziwe. Yilolu hlobo lokuxhumana okuzenzakalelayo phakathi kwamagama uma kungacaciswanga umsebenzi, isb. A B kufana no-A AND B.
help.search11: **I-OR:** Ithola izingenelo ezinanoma yiliphi lamagama achaziwe, isb. A OR B.
help.search13: Abasebenzi be-boolean kumele bafakwe ngamagama amakhulu.
help.search14: Ungasebenzisa amaqembu anengqondo (ngamabhrakethi) ukuze ususe ukungaqondakali lapho usebenzisa abasebenzi be-boolean abaningi, isb. (A OR B) AND C.
help.search15: Ungadinga ukulandelana okuqondile kwamagama (ngezingcingo ezimbili), isb. "A B C". Umehluko ozenzakalelayo phakathi kwezikhundla zamagama ungu-1, okusho ukuthi ingenelo izofana uma iqukethe amagama aseduze komunye nomunye, kodwa ingacaciswa ububanzi obuhlukile obukhulu (ngophawu lwe-tilde), isb. "Web Search"~2 ivumela kuze kube ngu-1 igama phakathi kuka-Web no-Search, okusho ukuthi ingafana nokusesha kwewebhusayithi kanye nokusesha kwewebhu.
help.exploreDesc: Le ngxenye ikuvumela ukuthi uphenye izigaba ezihlobene nezinkomba.
help.explore1: Izigaba zingasetshenziswa ukuhlunga ukusesha kwakho. Hlola isigaba ukuze usengeze ezinqubomgomweni zakho zokusesha futhi unciphise ukusesha kwakho. Imiphumela yakho yokusesha izobe ibonisa kuphela izingenelo ezihlotshaniswa naleso sigaba.
help.explore2: Susa itiki esigabeni ukuze usisuse ezinqubomgomweni zakho zokusesha futhi wandise imiphumela yokusesha.
help.explore3: Izinombolo ezibonakala eduze kwezigaba zibonisa ukuthi zingaki izingenelo ezihlotshaniswa nesigaba ngasinye emiphumeleni yamanje. Lezo zinombolo zizoshintsha ngokusho kwezinqubomgomo zakho zokusesha ukuze zihlale zichaza imiphumela yamanje. Ngokufanayo, izigaba nezici zonke zizonyamalala uma isethi yemiphumela ingenazo izingenelo ezihlotshaniswa nazo.
help.explore4: Isithonjana sophawu (v) esivela eduze kwesigaba sibonisa ukuthi kukhona izigaba ezingaphansi. Ungaqhafaza ukuze unwebe uhlu lwezigaba ezicacile kakhulu. Ungaqhafaza futhi kamuva ukuze uyigoqe. Ukunwebeka noma ukugoqwa kwezigaba ezingaphansi akuyikushintsha ukusesha kwakho kwamanje; lokhu kukuvumela ukuthi uphenye ngokushesha uhlelo lwezigaba uma ufuna.
help.resultsDesc: Le ngxenye ibonisa imiphumela yokusesha. Uma kungakanikezwa zinqubomgomo zokusesha, ibonisa okuqukethwe okugcwele kohlu lwencwadi (kuze kube izingenelo ezingu-20 ekhasini ngalinye).
help.results1: Ingenelo ngayinye yohlu lwemiphumela yixhumanisi erekhodini lalo lethalabhali eligcwele. Kusuka ekubukeni kwerekhodi lethalabhali, ungaqhubeka uphenya imiphumela yokusesha ngokuya emarekhodini adlule noma alandelayo emiphumeleni yakho yokusesha, noma ungabuyela ohlwini lwemiphumela.
help.results3: Inkinobho ethi **Izifinyezo** ikuvumela ukuthi uguqule ukubonakala kwezifinyezo ohlwini lwemiphumela yokusesha. Kodwa ukuvula izifinyezo akuyikuba nomthelela emiphumeleni engenayo isifinyezo.
help.results5: Ukuhlela ngokubaluleka kutholakala kuphela ngemva kokuthumela amagama okhiye usebenzisa ingxenye ethi **Sesha**.
help.results6: Izigaba ezikhethiwe engxenyeni ethi **Phenya** azinamthelela ekulinganiseni kokubaluleka. Umthelela wazo kuphela ukuhlunga uhlu lwemiphumela.

review-of-reviews.label: Ukubuyekeza kwezibuyekezo
review-of-reviews.description: Iqoqa futhi ifingqe izibuyekezo noma izimethahlaziyo zangaphambili, njengokubuyekeza okuhlanganisayo.
review-of-reviews.not: Akusona ukubuyekeza izifundo ezizodwa, okuyisibuyekezo esihlelekile noma esingokulandisa.

meta-analysis.label: Imethahlaziyo
meta-analysis.description: Ababhali ngokwabo bahlanganisa imiphumela yezifundo eziningana zangaphambili ngezibalo. Ukucaphuna imiphumela ehlanganisiwe yomunye umuntu akubalwa. Inikezwa kuphela uma isihloko, isifinyezo noma i-PDF kushoyo lokho.
meta-analysis.not: Akusona ukubuyekeza okucaphuna imiphumela ehlanganisiwe yomunye umuntu noma okungahlanganisi lutho, okuyisibuyekezo esihlelekile noma esingokulandisa.

systematic-review.label: Ukubuyekeza okuhlelekile
systematic-review.description: Ifingqa izifundo zangaphambili ezitholwe ngokusesha okuchaziwe nemithetho yokufaka, ngaphandle kokuzihlanganisa. Ihlanganisa ukubuyekeza kwesikali nokusheshayo.
systematic-review.not: Akusona ukubuyekeza okuhlanganisa imiphumela, okuyimethahlaziyo, noma okungenakusesha okuchaziwe, okuyisibuyekezo esingokulandisa.

literature-review.label: Ukubuyekeza okungokulandisa
literature-review.description: Ukubuyekeza okungokulandisa, okuhlolayo noma okuhlanganisayo okungenaindlela yokusesha echaziwe.
literature-review.not: Akusona ukubuyekeza okunemithetho echaziwe yokusesha nokufaka, okuyisibuyekezo esihlelekile.

bibliometric.label: Isifundo sebhibliyomethrikhi
bibliometric.description: Ibala futhi imephe izishicilelo, ababhali noma izibhekiselo ngetopiki, kunokuba ibale ukuthi izifundo zithole ini.
bibliometric.not: Akusona ukubuyekeza ukuthi izifundo zithole ini, okuyisibuyekezo esihlelekile noma esingokulandisa.

rct.label: Uvivinyo olungahleliwe
rct.description: Ababambiqhaza, amaqembu noma izindawo zabelwe izimo ngokungahleliwe. Inikezwa kuphela uma isihloko, isifinyezo noma i-PDF kushoyo lokho.
rct.not: Akusona ukuqhathanisa okungenakukhethwa ngokungahleliwe, okuyisifanekiso sovivinyo, noma ukubuyekeza kwezivivinyo.

quasi-experiment.label: Ukuhlola okufana nouvivinyo
quasi-experiment.description: Ukungenelela okuqhathaniswa neqembu lokuqhathanisa elikhethwe ngaphandle kokungahleliwe.
quasi-experiment.not: Akusona isifundo esinokungahleliwe, okuyisivivinyo esingahleliwe, noma esingenaqembu lokuqhathanisa, okuyisifundo sezibalo.

quantitative.label: Isifundo sezibalo
quantitative.description: Izinhlolovo, izifundo zokuhlobana nezokubukisisa, ukuhlola kwangaphambi nangemva kweqembu elilodwa, nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ekhona.
quantitative.not: Akusona ukuqhathanisa kwamaqembu ahlelwe, okuyivivinyo noma ukuhlola okufana nalo, noma ukwakhiwa noma ukuhlolwa kwemodeli, okuyisifundo sokwakha imodeli.

qualitative.label: Ikhwalithethivu noma izindlela ezixubile
qualitative.description: Izingxoxo, amaqembu agxile kokuthile, izifundo zamacala, i-ethnography noma ukuhlaziywa kwemibhalo, ngokwazo noma nedatha yezibalo.
qualitative.not: Akusona izibalo kuphela, ngaphandle kwezingxoxo, amacala noma imibhalo, okuyisifundo sezibalo.

modelling.label: Isifundo sokwakha imodeli
modelling.description: Yakha, ilingisa, iqagela noma ihlola imodeli, indlela, ithuluzi noma uhlelo, ihlolwe ngokuthi isebenza kahle kangakanani.
modelling.not: Akusona izibalo zedatha eqoqiwe ngaphandle kokwakha noma ukuhlola imodeli, okuyisifundo sezibalo.

protocol.label: Iprothokholi
protocol.description: Isifundo noma ukubuyekeza okuhleliwe noma okusaqhubeka, okungakabi nemiphumela okwamanje.

commentary.label: Ukuphawula
commentary.description: Isihloko sokuhlela, umbono, ukuhlaziywa kwenqubomgomo, umbono noma uhlaka olungenandaba entsha.
commentary.not: Akusona iphepha elinedatha entsha, noma ukubuyekeza kwezifundo.

not-research.label: Okunye
not-research.description: Idathasethi, isofthiwe, ukulungiswa, ukubuyekezwa kwencwadi, noma ifayela elihambisana nephepha elinye.
not-research.not: Akusona umbono noma isihloko senqubomgomo, okuyisimvo.
